newsitem.title: USA: Florsheim tender wins majority of consents.
newsitem.headline: Florsheim tender wins majority of consents.

text.p: Florsheim Group Inc on Monday said as of midnight April 18 holders of more than a majority of its outstanding 12-3/4 percent senior notes due 2002 had tendered notes and consents in connection with the company's March 31 cash solicitation.
As a result, the company and trustee under the indenture relating to the notes executed and delivered a supplemental indenture containing the amendments described in the company's offer.
The amendments will not become operative unless the notes are accepted for purchase in keeping with terms of the offer.
As previously reported, the shoe retailer's tender offer expires April 25 at midnight EDT.
